accordion.heading: Why bunny.net for my mittwald project?
accordion.intro: A CDN delivers images, CSS and JavaScript — or optionally the entire website — through a global network. The result: faster load times and less load on your server.

eu.heading: EU-based, GDPR-compliant
eu.text: bunny.net is headquartered in Slovenia (EU) — no US Cloud Act exposure. With the "EU-only PoPs" option, visitor data stays on European infrastructure end-to-end.

global.heading: Global network
global.text: 120+ locations worldwide for fast delivery to visitors everywhere.

typo3.heading: TYPO3-ready
typo3.text: Logged-in frontend users always see fresh, non-cached content.

price.heading: No base fee
price.text: You only pay for actual traffic — starting around €1/month for smaller sites.

step1.heading: Select a domain
step1.description: Pick the domain you want to enable the CDN for.
step1.empty: No domains were found in this mittwald project. Add a domain via the mittwald project settings (Domains → Connect domain), then come back here.

step2.heading: How should the CDN be used?
step2.description: Choose whether only static files or your entire website should be served through bunny.net.

assetCdn.heading: Asset CDN
assetCdn.description: Static files via CDN subdomain (e.g. <1>cdn.{{hostname}}</1>). The main domain stays at mittwald.
assetCdn.benefit: No risk, simple setup, instantly reversible

fullSiteCdn.heading: Full-Site CDN
fullSiteCdn.description: Entire website through bunny.net. <1>www.{{hostname}}</1> points to the CDN.
fullSiteCdn.benefit: All pages cached, automatic SSL, TYPO3-compatible
fullSiteCdn.downside: DNS change required, redirect from naked domain needed
fullSiteCdn.unavailable: Full-Site CDN needs an internal mittwald project URL as origin. It could not be determined right now — please use Asset CDN or contact support.

customHostname.heading: Custom hostname
customHostname.description: When the toggle is on we set up <1>{{subdomain}}</1> as your CDN address: mittwald creates the CNAME, bunny.net registers the hostname and automatically issues a free SSL certificate. When off you only get the neutral <1>[pullzone].b-cdn.net</1> URL and have to wire it into TYPO3 manually.
customHostname.toggle: Set up the custom hostname automatically

step3.heading: All set!
step3.description: Review your selection and click "Set up now". bunny.net will create a pull zone for your website. You'll get a step-by-step guide afterwards.

withCustomHostname.step1: A pull zone is created at bunny.net for your static files.
withCustomHostname.step2: <1>cdn.{{hostname}}</1> is registered as a hostname at bunny.net and a free SSL certificate is issued.
withCustomHostname.step3: The DNS record <1>cdn.{{hostname}}</1> is created automatically at mittwald.
withCustomHostname.step4: You land on the dashboard with the CDN domain, configuration snippets (for TYPO3 and friends), and the traffic analytics.

withoutCustomHostname.step1: A pull zone is created at bunny.net for your static files.
withoutCustomHostname.step2: You get the neutral <1>[pullzone].b-cdn.net</1> URL. The custom hostname (<1>cdn.{{hostname}}</1>) can be enabled from the dashboard later.
withoutCustomHostname.step3: You land on the dashboard with the CDN domain and the configuration snippets for your TYPO3 setup.

fullSite.step1: A pull zone with SSL and TYPO3 edge rules is created.
fullSite.step2: The DNS record <1>www.{{hostname}}</1> is switched over to bunny.net automatically.

step4.heading: Pull zone created successfully
step4.intro: Follow the steps below to finish setup. Afterwards you'll land on the dashboard where you can manage traffic, settings, and the cache.

ssl.title: SSL certificate
ssl.description: A free Let's Encrypt certificate is issued automatically for {{hostname}}. This can take up to 15 minutes.

cache.title: Cache behaviour
cache.description: Logged-in TYPO3 frontend users are automatically excluded from the cache. For content changes use the cache-purge button on the dashboard.

redirect.title: Set up a redirect
redirect.description: Make sure {{nakedDomain}} redirects via 301 to {{hostname}}. mittwald usually handles this through the domain settings.

dashboard.title: CDN dashboard
dashboard.zonePausedBanner: The pull zone is currently paused. Content is not served via the CDN — visitors hit the origin server directly.

actions.changeApiKeyDescription: Enter your new bunny.net API key. You can find it at <1>dash.bunny.net/account/api-key</1>.
actions.changeApiKeyHint: The stored key will be replaced. bunny.net validates the new key before saving — if it is invalid, the old key stays active.

serving.heading: Serve traffic via the CDN
serving.description: When disabled, requests go directly to your mittwald server, bypassing the CDN. Configuration is retained — you can switch back any time.

purgeCache.heading: Purge cache
purgeCache.description: Clears all cached content at the bunny.net edge. Useful after a TYPO3 deployment so visitors immediately see the new version.

cacheTtl.heading: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long bunny.net caches content before refetching from origin. "Origin" means: respect the mittwald server's Cache-Control header.

smartCache.heading: Smart cache
smartCache.description: bunny.net picks cache lifetimes automatically based on content type: short for HTML, much longer for static assets (CSS, JS, images, fonts). Cache-Control headers from the origin are overridden.
smartCache.recommendation: Useful if your origin does not send precise Cache-Control headers. If TYPO3 sets specific Cache-Control headers, leave this off and use Edge-Cache "Origin" above instead.
smartCache.docsLink: Smart Cache in the bunny.net docs
smartCache.helpText: Smart Cache classifies responses at the bunny.net edge by content type. HTML / dynamic content gets a short TTL (default ~15 minutes), static assets get a long one (up to one year). Both TTLs override the Cache-Control header from your origin.

imageOptimizer.heading: Image optimization
imageOptimizer.description: bunny.net converts images on the fly into modern formats (WebP, AVIF). Saves up to 70% bandwidth at the same image quality.
imageOptimizer.pricingPrefix: Heads up: enabling this starts billing immediately per pull zone. Current pricing:

minify.heading: Minify CSS & JavaScript
minify.description: Removes whitespace and comments from your assets. Only enable this if TYPO3 isn't already minifying.

cdnRegions.heading: CDN regions
cdnRegions.description: Restrict delivery to European servers for maximum GDPR compliance. Disables all PoPs outside the EU.
cdnRegions.dpaHint: For full GDPR compliance, the Data Processing Agreement (DPA) should also be accepted at bunny.net.

hotlink.heading: Hotlink protection
hotlink.description: Prevents other websites from linking directly to your CDN resources and burning your bandwidth. Only requests from the domains listed here are served.
hotlink.referrersHelp: One domain per line, e.g. example.com, www.example.com
hotlink.emptyWarning: Without at least one allowed referrer, every request would be blocked. Please enter at least one domain.

paused.heading: Zone paused
paused.text: The pull zone is currently disabled — no new analytics are being collected. Use the toggle at the top of any tab to re-enable the zone.

empty.heading: No data yet
empty.text: Once the first traffic flows through your CDN, charts and KPIs will appear here.

analyticsTab.avgOriginResponse: Avg. origin response on cache miss
analyticsTab.cachePerformanceExplainer: The top value is the share of traffic that did not hit your mittwald server. The origin response time only applies on cache misses — the higher the hit rate, the rarer you notice it.

dangerZone.label: Remove CDN setup
dangerZone.description: 'Delete permanently' removes the pull zone, DNS record, and all extension data irreversibly. 'Detach' keeps the pull zone at bunny.net so you can keep managing it from the bunny.net dashboard.
dangerZone.confirmChoice: How would you like to proceed?
dangerZone.deleteHint: Deletes the pull zone at bunny.net, removes the DNS record (CNAME), and all extension data. Cannot be undone.
dangerZone.detachHint: Leaves the pull zone at bunny.net intact — you keep managing it via the bunny.net dashboard. The DNS record remains in place for now.

integrationTab.heading: Integration
integrationTab.description: CMS- and shop-specific configuration hints for your CDN. Each integration carries the matching caching rules, snippets, and recommendations so your system works smoothly with bunny.net. Currently TYPO3 is supported — more integrations (e.g. Shopware, WordPress) follow.

customHostname.heading: Custom hostname
customHostname.fullSiteOnly: Full-Site CDN uses <1>{{hostname}}</1> as the CDN address. This hostname is a core part of full-site mode and cannot be toggled off.
customHostname.enabledText: Your CDN address <1>{{hostname}}</1> is registered at bunny.net with a free SSL certificate. Disabling removes the hostname and the mittwald CNAME — visitors will then need to be moved to <1>{{cdnDomain}}</1>.
customHostname.disabledText: Enabling sets up <1>{{hostname}}</1> as your CDN address: mittwald creates the CNAME, bunny.net registers the hostname and issues an SSL certificate. Without a custom hostname, traffic is served via <1>{{cdnDomain}}</1>.
customHostname.busy: Applying change — bunny.net, mittwald DNS, and database are being synced…
customHostname.confirmDisable: Really disable the custom hostname? Existing visitors will get DNS errors until they switch to the .b-cdn.net URL.

asset.heading: Configure the CDN domain in TYPO3
asset.description: For TYPO3 to serve static files via {{cdnDomain}}, add the following TypoScript to your setup:

fullSite.heading: Full-Site CDN configuration
fullSite.description: With Full-Site CDN all traffic runs through bunny.net. Logged-in frontend users bypass the cache automatically via the edge rule. Enable cache headers so bunny.net can cache optimally:

snippet.asset:
# TYPO3 TypoScript: serve static files through the CDN
page.headerData.10 = TEXT
page.headerData.10.value = <base href="https://{{cdnDomain}}/">

# Or via config:
config.absRefPrefix = https://{{cdnDomain}}/
snippet.fullSite:
# Full-Site CDN: no TypoScript change required.
# Your domain points directly at bunny.net.
# Enable cache headers:
config.sendCacheHeaders = 1

cacheHeaders.heading: Enable cache headers
cacheHeaders.description: So bunny.net knows how long content may be cached, enable cache headers in TYPO3:

imageOpt.heading: Image optimization
imageOpt.description: The bunny.net Optimizer converts images to WebP automatically and minifies CSS/JS. Enable it in the Settings tab or directly in the bunny.net dashboard.

loggedIn.heading: Logged-in users
loggedIn.fullSite: An edge rule is active: when the "fe_typo_user" cookie is set, the cache is bypassed. Logged-in frontend users always see fresh content.
loggedIn.asset: Asset CDN only caches static files (images, CSS, JS). Dynamic pages come straight from your mittwald server — logged-in users are not affected.

deployment.heading: After deployment
deployment.description: Purge the CDN cache after every TYPO3 deployment so changes appear immediately. You can do this from the actions menu (⋯) in the top right.

support.heading: Support & feedback
support.text: Questions, problems, or feature requests? We'd love to hear from you — pull requests welcome too.
